observations: Photo 0: A complete engine assembly with cylinder head cover, attached struts/coil springs, injector wiring and hoses, sitting on a wet paved yard among other dismantled parts.
Photo 1: Same or similar assembly showing underside with a driveshaft/transfer case, CV axle, brake caliper and more scrap parts in background.
Photo 2: Different angle of the engine with transmission/transfer case attached, same red-painted engine cover visible.
A watermark reading 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' appears across all three photos, but this is the seller's shop branding, not a visible plate, sticker, or stamped model number on the engine itself.
No engine code, VIN plate, or part number sticker is legible in any photo.
No ignition test, oil check, or compression test is shown; engine could not be confirmed to run.

identity.kind: complete used engine assembly with attached suspension/driveline parts

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim, not tied to a specific photo or item.

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model unknown, which drives price from roughly 750k to 5m in comparables
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine code/stamp, VIN plate, or a shot of the vehicle badge it was pulled from
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since worst-case and best-case span too wide a range

risks.risk: Engine may be non-running or have internal damage (knock, seized, blown head gasket)
risks.proof: Video of engine cranking/running or compression test results

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (turbo, injectors, sensors, wiring harness) cannot be confirmed as functional, only visually present
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each major accessory with continuity/bench test

risks.risk: Mileage/history of the donor vehicle is unknown
risks.proof: Odometer photo or donor vehicle documentation

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/stamp or VIN plate to identify make and model
Photo or video of the donor vehicle (badge, dashboard) this engine was removed from
Video of the engine cranking or running
Compression test or oil condition photo
response.reason: The photos show a complete used engine assembly but no readable code, plate, or model marking, and the seller's text gives no item-specific details; without knowing the make/model, the comparables span too wide a range (hundreds of thousands to several million NGN) to set even a worst-case price.
